item: Peak+ to create 96 jobs making data center cooling products in Shelby County
findings: TNECD's Nov. 10, 2026 release confirms Memphis-based Peak+ will create 96 jobs and invest $845,000 in a new location at 3696 Knight Road, Shelby County, making adiabatic pre-cooling systems for HVAC equipment in response to data center demand for lower electricity use and reliable cooling.

key: stories|Tennessee awards $422 million in Rural Health Transformation grants to 138 projects
item: Tennessee awards $422 million in Rural Health Transformation grants to 138 projects
findings: The Tennessee Department of Health's Nov. 9, 2026 release confirms RHTP awards to 138 grantee projects representing more than $422 million over the next five years of the program's lifecycle, aimed at expanding access to care for rural Tennesseans. The item's 'about $422 million' is a fair rounding of 'more than $422 million'.

key: stories|Marshall Graves named chair of the State Workforce Development Board
item: Marshall Graves named chair of the State Workforce Development Board
findings: TDLWD's Nov. 9, 2026 release confirms Gov. Bill Lee appointed Marshall Graves of Grundy County, previously vice chair, as chair of the State Workforce Development Board, succeeding Tim Berry, who led the board for eight years. Graves is a partner with Stone Door Group, a Tennessee IT services and consulting firm.

key: stories|Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
item: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
findings: Anthropic's Nov. 9, 2026 announcement confirms upgraded Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, with Fable 5.2 available on all platforms including AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure, and Mythos 5.2 available to vetted organizations through its Cyber and Life Sciences Verification Programs. Pricing is $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens (fast mode $16/$80).

key: stories|TNECD makes the case for German medtech companies locating in Tennessee
item: TNECD makes the case for German medtech companies locating in Tennessee
findings: TNECD's Nov. 9, 2026 article by Steffen Bayer, its Director of Business Development for Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the Benelux countries, says Tennessee ranks third nationally in medtech production and exports and that more than 115 German companies employ nearly 20,000 people in the state. It argues German medtech firms are looking to the U.S. market.

key: stories|U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October; unemployment fell to 4.1%
item: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October; unemployment fell to 4.1%
findings: The linked IndustryWeek article could not be opened (the host is blocked in this session). A WebSearch result page summarizing the BLS Employment Situation release for October 2026 shows nonfarm payrolls up 165,000 and the unemployment rate at 4.1% (down from 4.2%), and TDLWD's Nov. 19, 2026 release independently confirms the 4.1% national rate, down one-tenth from September. bls.gov and dol.gov could not be opened directly.
suggested_fix: Link the BLS Employment Situation release for October 2026 instead of, or alongside, the IndustryWeek article.

key: stories|BWXT to invest $714.5 million and create 181 jobs in Jonesborough, Washington County
item: BWXT to invest $714.5 million and create 181 jobs in Jonesborough, Washington County
findings: TNECD's Nov. 6, 2026 release confirms BWXT will invest $714.5 million and create 181 jobs in Jonesborough, Washington County, producing High Purity Depleted Uranium (HPDU) metal for NNSA, supported by a TNECD Nuclear Energy Fund grant (BWXT's third fund project and the fund's 12th).

key: stories|ABB to invest $50 million and create 227 jobs in Selmer, McNairy County
item: ABB to invest $50 million and create 227 jobs in Selmer, McNairy County
findings: TNECD's Nov. 5, 2026 release confirms ABB's Industrial Connections & Solutions division will invest $50 million in a new 120,000-square-foot facility in Selmer, McNairy County, making and distributing busway and bus plug systems and other electrical products, creating 227 jobs.
